title: Expose behavior while protecting fields
summary: Keep a record’s state private to its module, and provide public construction, inspection and mutation methods.

visible.clue: Unrestricted visibility keyword on Counter, without limiting access to the current crate or parent module

record.clue: Keyword declaring the named-field Counter type

implementation.clue: Keyword introducing methods associated with Counter

selfType.clue: Type alias spelling for Counter within its implementation

shared.clue: Receiver permitting value inspection without consuming or mutating Counter

exclusive.clue: Receiver permitting the private field to be changed through a public method

binding.clue: Modifier allowing the counter binding to be borrowed exclusively

equal.clue: Macro checking the value after two public increments
